Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to give one of my originally unsuspended Digimon ?

Effect: [Main] Unsuspend 1 of your Digimon. Until the end of your opponent's next turn, that Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
Security Effect: [Security] Unsuspend 1 of your Digimon. That Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead) for the turn.
